newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE assigns CARE AA+ rating to HSAL.
newsitem.headline: India's CARE assigns CARE AA+ rating to HSAL.

text.p: India's Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said on Wednesday that Hoechst Schering AgrEvo Ltd (HSAL) has been assigned a "CARE AA+" Double A plus rating to the Fixed Deposit programme of Hoechst Schering AgrEvo Ltd (HSAL) upto 30 million rupees.
Instruments carrying this rating are judged to be of high quality by all standards. They are also classified as high investment grade, it said in a statement.

HSAL was incorporated in 1994, to take over the agro-chemical division of Hoechst India Ltd, which has been in the agro-chemical business since 1984. HSAL is a subsidiary of Hoechst Schering AgrEvo Gmbh, the world's second largest agro-chemical company, with a total income of about DM 3.4 billion rupees, during FY'96.
